verdict.rationale: This is a single-purpose logo-design skill in the open Agent Skills format (a folder with a SKILL.md). Skill-authoring tooling is a fair question for products in that ecosystem, so the axis applies. However, the evidence shows no spec, template, or meta-skill for an agent to author a new skill. The tools/package_skill.py script only packages this logo-design skill for upload; it is not a workflow for creating new skills, so the story is unevidenced.
